map.基于操作难度相关因素，评估ERCP取石和支架置入的成功概率: Assess the success probability of ERCP stone removal and stent placement based on procedural difficulty factors.
map.「基于操作难度相关因素，评估ERCP取石和支架置入的成功概率」按输入参数进行专业: Assess the success probability of ERCP stone removal and stent placement based on procedural difficulty factors. Computes professionally from the input parameters and outputs the result.
map.ERCP取石支架成功概率评估器: ERCP Stone Removal and Stent Success Probability Assessor
map.📋 ERCP 难度分级（Cotton 1–4 级框架的本页 3 档简化）: 📋 ERCP difficulty grading (3-tier simplification of the Cotton 1-4 framework)
map.胆管深插管、标准取石（＜10mm）、单根塑料支架: Biliary duct cannulation, standard stone removal (<10mm), single plastic stent
map.大结石（≥10mm）取石、多枚结石、双支架置入: Large stone (≥10mm) removal, multiple stones, dual stent placement
map.肝内胆管取石、恶性狭窄支架、乳头旁憩室: Intrahepatic bile duct stone removal, malignant stricture stenting, peripapillary diverticulum
map.成功率受术者经验、设备条件和患者解剖因素综合影响。: Success rate is jointly influenced by operator experience, equipment conditions, and patient anatomic factors.
map.成功率为本页教学用估算区间，非 Cotton 原表或指南推荐数值；实际成功率还受: The success ranges are teaching estimates on this page, not values from the original Cotton table or a guideline. Actual success also depends on operator experience, equipment and anatomy, and requires clinical review.
map.⚠️ 需临床复核：本页为教学用简化估算。Cotton 等（ASGE 工作组，Ga: ⚠️ Requires clinical review: this page is a simplified teaching estimate. The original Cotton et al. framework (ASGE working party, Gastrointest Endosc 2011) has 4 grades; this page merges them into 3 tiers, and the weights and success ranges are page-specific, not guideline values. It cannot replace an endoscopist's preoperative assessment.
map.参考 Cotton 等（2011）1–4 级难度框架，本页简化为 3 档并给出本: Based on the Cotton et al. (2011) 1-4 difficulty framework, simplified to 3 tiers with page-specific success estimates; thresholds and weights require clinical review.
map.难度分 = 操作目的(取石/良性支架+3/恶性支架+2) + 结石(大小>15m: Difficulty = purpose (stone removal / benign stent +3 / malignant stent +2) + stone (size >15mm +3, 10-15mm +2, <10mm +1; multiple +1-2; intrahepatic +3, proximal +2, middle +1) + anatomy (Billroth II +2, Roux-en-Y +3, periampullary diverticulum +1, prior EST -1). Grading (this page's simplification): ≤2 = grade 1 (standard, page estimate 90-95%); ≤5 = grade 2 (advanced, 80-90%); >5 = grade 3 (complex, 60-80%).
map.⚠️ 需临床复核：评分权重与成功率区间为本页教学用简化估算（非指南原文），实际难: ⚠️ Requires clinical review: the weights and success ranges are page-specific teaching estimates, not guideline values. Actual difficulty and strategy must be judged by an endoscopist using imaging, history and intraoperative findings.
map.请输入 1–100 mm 的结石最大径；若本次不是取石，请把操作目的切换为支架置: Enter a maximum stone diameter of 1-100 mm; if this is not stone removal, switch the purpose to stenting.
map.结石嵌顿或位置高（肝内胆管）: Impacted stone or high position (intrahepatic bile duct)
map.EUS引导下胆管穿刺（EUS-BD）：困难插管时: EUS-guided biliary drainage (EUS-BD): when cannulation is difficult
map.经口胆道镜（SpyGlass）：直视下碎石: Peroral cholangioscopy (SpyGlass): lithotripsy under direct vision
map.预切开（针刀/短导丝）：困难插管时: Precut (needle-knife/short guidewire): when cannulation is difficult
map.提示：ERCP是胆胰疾病的重要诊治手段，但属高难度操作，并发症发生率约5-10%: Note: ERCP is an important diagnostic and therapeutic tool for biliary-pancreatic disease, but it is a high-difficulty procedure with a complication rate of about 5-10% (pancreatitis, bleeding, perforation, infection). High-difficulty cases should be referred to experienced centers or consider alternatives such as EUS-BD. For clinical reference only.
map.📚 深度解析：ERCP 取石/支架成功概率评估: 📚 Deep Dive: ERCP Stone Removal/Stent Success Probability Assessment
map.术前决策：由结石大小、数量、位置与解剖因素估操作难度: Preoperative decision: estimate procedural difficulty from stone size, number, location, and anatomic factors
map.风险告知：向患者说明预估成功率与可能的辅助技术: Risk disclosure: explain the estimated success rate and possible adjunct techniques to the patient
map.转诊判断：复杂难度转高容量中心或 EUS 辅助: Referral judgment: complex difficulty should be referred to a high-volume center or use EUS assistance
map.算法（取石）：结石 >15mm→+3（需碎石）、10~15mm→+2、<10mm: Algorithm (stone removal): stone >15mm→+3 (lithotripsy needed), 10~15mm→+2, <10mm→+1; number ≥4→+2, 2~3→+1, single→0; location intrahepatic→+3, proximal CBD/hilum→+2, middle→+1, distal→0; benign stricture stent +3, malignant obstruction +2; post Roux-en-Y +3, Billroth II +2; periampullary diverticulum +1; EST already performed −1 (take 0 when difficulty <0). Difficulty ≤2 → grade 1 (success 90~95%), ≤5 → grade 2 (80~90%), >5 → grade 3 (60~80%).
map.例：胆总管中段结石 12mm、2~3 枚、无手术史 → +2+1+1 = 难度: Example: middle CBD stone 12mm, 2~3 stones, no surgical history → +2+1+1 = difficulty 4, grade 2 (estimated success 80~90%), routine EST + basket extraction. If intrahepatic bile duct stone 20mm, ≥4 stones, post Roux-en-Y, with diverticulum → +3+2+3+3+1 = difficulty 12, grade 3 (60~80%); a high-volume center or EUS-BD/SpyGlass direct vision with staged procedures is advised. These scores and success ranges are teaching simplifications; actual difficulty requires clinical review.
map.提示：ERCP 是胆胰疾病的重要诊治手段，但属高难度操作。Cotton 等（20: Note: ERCP is an important biliary-pancreatic diagnostic and therapeutic procedure, but it is high-difficulty. Cotton et al. (2009) and ASGE adverse-event reviews commonly cite overall complications around 5-10% (post-ERCP pancreatitis, bleeding, perforation, cholangitis), rising with case complexity. High-difficulty cases should be referred to experienced centers or consider EUS-BD alternatives. This page is a teaching estimate and requires clinical review.
map.难度 3 级就做不了 ERCP 吗？: Does grade 3 difficulty mean ERCP cannot be done?
map.不是不能做，而是成功率降至 60%~80% 且并发症风险升高，需由经验丰富的内镜: It is not that it cannot be done, but the success rate drops to 60%~80% with higher complication risk, so it needs an experienced endoscopist or referral. EUS-guided puncture, peroral cholangioscopy (SpyGlass) for direct-vision lithotripsy, and balloon-assisted endoscopy can raise the success rate.
map.EST 为什么能降低难度？: Why does EST lower the difficulty?
map.内镜下括约肌切开（EST）扩张了乳头开口，便于取石网篮/球囊通过，故已行 EST: Endoscopic sphincterotomy (EST) dilates the papillary opening so the extraction basket/balloon can pass, hence EST already performed scores −1. But for patients not yet cut, the first cut itself also counts toward difficulty, so comprehensive assessment is needed.
